angular_error: Angle between normalized (x-cx,y-cy,f) camera rays, f=160/tan(42°), Euclidean 3D angle <= 5°
forced_choice: one x,y candidate every frame where sensory peaks exist
no_target_gate_threshold: 99th percentile of no-target maximum evidence, calibration frames 25–99
random_baseline: uniform x/y sampled in 12..308 rectangle, 300 simulations per trajectory; always outputs a position
note: Simulated 6mm mosquito injected into 320x320 images after area downsampling; this is not a physical event-camera measurement.
